title: The return from Egypt
author: Hajime Murai
note: 2022 downloadable source snapshot. Relationship labels are source data; explanation wording is ChiFold editorial. Source Bible quotations are excluded. Subverse elements show whole verses as context.

nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
The travel of Joseph's family.
The messages of dreams correspond to the practices of Joseph. The last verse also emphasizes the fulfillment of the words of the Bible (Isaiah 11:1). Based on prevailing theory, "Nazareth" is derived from Hebrew word Hebrew{ncr} which means branch
